title: Vanilla Create
description: The collection includes a wide variety of mods that add new biomes, structures, and mobs. The core mod is Create, along with a large number of add-ons.
body:
This build includes a wide variety of mods that add new biomes, structures, and mobs. The main mod is Create, along with a large number of add-ons. The build also includes mods for furniture, decor, and a wide selection of building blocks.

Overall, download and see for yourself what this build has to offer.

A word of warning: when launching the game, it's recommended to increase your memory to at least 4 GB, otherwise the game may become unstable.
